about: SYNTHETIC recall set modelled on coding-agent notes (a fictional shop backend). Replace or extend with notes and queries replayed from your own sessions (docs/roadmap.md, item 1).

notes.summary: Use sqlx with Postgres; no ORM
notes.content: We chose sqlx over diesel: compile-time checked queries, async, and the team already knows SQL. Migrations live in db/migrations and run through sqlx migrate.

notes.summary: Money is stored as integer cents
notes.content: All prices and totals are i64 cents (price_cents). Never use floats for money. Currency is a separate ISO-4217 column.

notes.summary: Refund webhook retries cause double refunds
notes.content: Stripe retries the refund webhook; handler process_refund() must be idempotent using the event id stored in refund_events. A missing check refunded twice in March.

notes.summary: Do not run cargo test without the test database
notes.content: Tests need TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at shop_test. Running against dev wipes the carts table.

notes.summary: CI runs clippy with -D warnings
notes.content: The GitHub Actions job lint runs cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, then cargo fmt --check.

notes.summary: Feature flags live in config/flags.toml
notes.content: Flags are read at startup, not per request. A flag change needs a restart. Naming: snake_case, prefixed by area, e.g. checkout_express_pay.

notes.summary: CartService::apply_coupon mutated the cart twice
notes.content: Bug: apply_coupon was called from both the controller and the pricing hook, doubling discounts. Fixed by moving the call into PricingEngine::recalculate only.

notes.summary: API responses must stay under 200 KB
notes.content: The mobile app crashes on larger JSON. Paginate list endpoints at 50 items and never inline images.

notes.summary: Staging deploys from the release/* branches
notes.content: Merging to main does not deploy. Cut release/2026-11 and push; the deploy workflow picks it up and posts to #deploys.

notes.summary: Timestamps are UTC in the database
notes.content: created_at columns are timestamptz stored in UTC. The frontend converts to the shop's timezone using shop.tz. Do not call Local::now() in services.

notes.summary: Auth uses short-lived JWT plus refresh token cookie
notes.content: Access token 15 minutes, refresh token 30 days in an HttpOnly cookie. Revocation list in Redis key auth:revoked.

notes.summary: N+1 query in OrderList caused slow dashboard
notes.content: OrderRepository::list loaded line items one by one. Fixed with a single JOIN and group by order_id; dashboard went from 4 s to 300 ms.

notes.summary: Search uses Meilisearch, reindex with make reindex
notes.content: Product search is Meilisearch on port 7700. After bulk import run make reindex; the index name is products_v3.

notes.summary: Never edit generated files in src/gen
notes.content: src/gen/api_types.ts is generated from openapi.yaml by npm run codegen. Manual edits are overwritten.

notes.summary: Errors use thiserror in libraries, anyhow in binaries
notes.content: Library crates define typed errors with thiserror. Binary crates convert with anyhow::Context for readable messages.

notes.summary: Redis connection pool exhausted under load test
notes.content: Pool size 10 was too small for 200 concurrent checkouts. Set REDIS_POOL_MAX=64 and added a timeout of 500 ms.

notes.summary: Email templates are in templates/mail and use MJML
notes.content: Run npm run mail:build to compile MJML to HTML. Order confirmation is order_confirmed.mjml.

notes.summary: Product images are served from the CDN only
notes.content: Never link to /uploads directly. Use cdn_url(path) so cache headers and resizing apply.

notes.summary: Background jobs use the jobs table, not a broker
notes.content: A worker polls the jobs table with SKIP LOCKED. We rejected RabbitMQ to keep operations small.

notes.summary: Locale files must be sorted
notes.content: The i18n lint fails when keys in locales/en.json are not alphabetical. Run npm run i18n:sort before committing.

notes.summary: Migration 0042 locked the orders table for 9 minutes
notes.content: Adding a NOT NULL column with a default rewrote the table. Use ADD COLUMN nullable, backfill in batches, then set NOT NULL.

notes.summary: Rate limit is 100 requests per minute per API key
notes.content: Implemented in the tower layer RateLimitLayer; limit keyed by x-api-key, falls back to IP.

notes.summary: Tax is computed by the TaxCalculator trait
notes.content: Tax rules differ per country; each has a struct implementing TaxCalculator. EU VAT uses the destination country and the customer's VAT id.

notes.summary: Do not log request bodies
notes.content: Bodies can contain card tokens and addresses. Use the redact_headers middleware and log only the route and status.

notes.summary: Order states: pending, paid, shipped, cancelled
notes.content: State changes go through OrderStateMachine::transition. Direct UPDATE of status is rejected by a database trigger.

notes.summary: Flaky test checkout_e2e fails on port 3000
notes.content: The test starts a server on a fixed port. Use port 0 and read the bound address; it stopped the flake.

notes.summary: Frontend state with Pinia stores per domain
notes.content: One store per domain (cart, session, catalog). No global mega-store. Stores never call each other directly; use events.

notes.summary: Shipping rates come from the CarrierGateway adapter
notes.content: Adapters for DHL and UPS implement CarrierGateway::quote. Rates are cached for 10 minutes by postcode and weight.

notes.summary: The dev seed script resets all passwords
notes.content: scripts/seed_dev.sh sets every user password to devpass. Never run it against staging.

notes.summary: Supported browsers: last two Safari and Chrome versions
notes.content: IE and old Edge are out of scope. No polyfills for optional chaining.

notes.summary: Currency conversion uses daily ECB rates
notes.content: Rates are fetched at 02:00 UTC into the fx_rates table and never converted live at checkout.

notes.summary: Memory leak from unclosed websocket subscriptions
notes.content: Components must call unsubscribe in onUnmounted. The orders page leaked 40 MB per hour.

notes.summary: Production database backups run nightly at 03:00
notes.content: pg_dump to s3://shop-backups/nightly, kept 30 days. Restore drill is the first Monday of the month.

notes.summary: Code review needs one approval and green CI
notes.content: Branch protection: one approving review, all checks green, linear history by squash merge.

notes.summary: Date filters are inclusive on the start, exclusive on the end
notes.content: Report queries use created_at >= from AND created_at < to. Off-by-one here duplicated a day in the March report.

notes.summary: The admin panel lives under /ops and needs the ops role
notes.content: Routes in src/admin/ are mounted at /ops. Role check is in the AdminGuard extractor.

notes.summary: Large CSV export timed out the request
notes.content: Exports over 10k rows must be a background job that emails a link; streaming in the request hit the 30 s gateway timeout.

notes.summary: Docker images must be built for linux/arm64 and amd64
notes.content: The release workflow uses buildx with both platforms; a single-arch push breaks the Graviton nodes.

notes.summary: Naming: services end in Service, repos in Repository
notes.content: CartService, OrderRepository. Controllers are thin and only map HTTP to service calls.

notes.summary: Sentry DSN is read from SENTRY_DSN, empty disables it
notes.content: Release is tagged with the git sha by build.rs. Source maps upload happens in the deploy job.
